summary: CR-046 Settings UI Completion - Verified all 7 settings groups are visible with correct settings. Master account sees 'Affects all stores' badges, child account sees lock icons and disabled toggles on masterOnly groups. Toggle functionality works correctly.

discrepancy.issue: Test requirements mention 'FEFO Consumption Tracking' (fefo_consumption_enabled) in Transfer Behavior group, but this setting is NOT in the code. Code has 25 settings, requirements mention 26.
discrepancy.note: This may be intentional - the setting might not have been included in CR-046 scope

settings_groups_visibility.details: All 7 groups visible: Hierarchy Policy, Transfer Behavior, Alerts & Thresholds, Transfer Pricing, Production, Purchase Orders, System

transfer_behavior_group.note: FEFO setting NOT present in code (requirements mention 5 settings)

toggle_functionality.details: Toggle 'Allow Shipping Fee' changed from checked to unchecked and back. Changes persisted after page refresh. Backend API calls return 200 OK.

child_account_restrictions.details: Franchise account (palmbharat) sees lock icons on masterOnly groups (Hierarchy Policy, Transfer Pricing). Toggles are disabled. Settings show 'Inherited from #813' badges.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add 'fefo_consumption_enabled' setting to Transfer Behavior group if it was intended to be part of CR-046 (currently missing from SETTING_GROUPS array)
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-046 Settings UI verified. All 7 groups display correctly. Toggle functionality works. Child accounts see locked masterOnly groups. Note: FEFO setting mentioned in requirements is not in the code - may need clarification if this was intentional.
